name: smwpatches-free-188a
title: Free 188A
description:
This is a minor patch that slightly modifies some code near the 'Kill Mario' routine at $00F606 to do the following:
1) Remove the STZ to $188A at the tail end of the routine (which is normally cleared during powering down and upon dying), allowing it to be used as proper intra-level freeram, and
2) Adds a couple defines to allow storing zero to a different ram address on death (but not on powerdown) if desired. By default, the patch will disable vertical scrolling to more efficiently replicate this uberasm.
